tests.expected: Only one metadata/comment batch; all protected geometry and records identical to revision 6
tests.actual: Revision 7 has the same global 110 instances, 110 solids, 831 faces, bounds and 783118.7195908069 mm3 volume as revision 6; no per-instance coincident-body/topology diff or native revision-diff record was produced
tests.tolerance: exact identity and topology; native kernel tolerance not reported

tests.expected: 110 identifiable instances/solids, 18 printed definitions, 28 printed instances, zero errors, editable articulation
tests.actual: 110 instances, 110 solids, 18 printed definitions, 28 printed instances, zero component errors; source and native joints remain readable/editable

tests.expected: mm, degrees, right-handed +X right/+Y rear/+Z up
tests.actual: Built units mm and deg; native captures report CAD Z-up, front from -Y and right from +X

tests.expected: Explicit stationary-group XY footprint <=200 x 180 mm
tests.actual: Tray local envelope is exactly 200 x 180 mm, but no explicit complete stationary-group selection bounding box was measured

tests.expected: PCB rear, pedestal front; reserved-bay intersection 0 mm3 in five states
tests.actual: PCB bounds are X[-80,80], Y[90,180], Z[12,13.6] mm and captures show it rearward; exact reserved-bay intersection volumes were not reported for the five states

tests.expected: 100+/-0.1 mm and 90+/-0.1 mm spacings; 18 x 18 mm sections; planes X=-9.4/+9.4 mm
tests.actual: 100.0 mm, 90.0 mm, sections 18.0 x 18.0 mm, upper/palm X=-9.4 mm and forearm X=+9.4 mm
tests.tolerance: +/-0.1 mm spacing; exact supplied section/plane values

tests.expected: Closed 5.4 mm bores, 5.0 mm shafts, radial gap >=0.19 mm, proper axes and through-depths
tests.actual: Machining inspection found 5.4 mm pitch bores and 5.0 mm shafts; derived radial gap=(5.4-5.0)/2=0.20 mm; pitch axes are -X with 18 mm link/palm and 8 mm yoke-cheek through lengths; yaw is the specified +Z axis
tests.tolerance: gap >=0.19 mm; diameter native tolerance not separately reported

tests.expected: Non-seat printed gaps >=0.4 mm and no unenumerated overlap through named states and bounded path
tests.actual: Each named fit checked 5995 pairs with zero issues and 25 explicit zero-overlap seated pairs; the 33-sample path reported zero collisions, but did not report every path-sample minimum distance
tests.tolerance: 0.4 mm non-seat gap; 0 mm3 non-seat overlap

tests.expected: Five cradle definitions; every instance one connected solid; each boss web volume >0 mm3
tests.actual: Only four unique cradle component definitions are present (saddle_yaw, saddle_large, saddle_small, saddle_gripper), used for five instances. Every reported cradle body is one solid, but isolated boss-web volumes were not computed
tests.tolerance: definition count exactly 5; connected regions exactly 1; web volume >0 mm3

tests.expected: Outward retained M5 stacks, exactly 25 M3 bolt/nut stacks and explicit hardware contact pairs
tests.actual: BOM contains 25 M3 bolts and 25 M3 nuts, plus 1 yaw shaft, 3 pitch shafts, 8 washers and 4 M5 nuts. Source exposes explicit printed-seat contacts but no explicit hardware component-pair contact declarations or complete measured stack-order table
tests.tolerance: exact counts; wildcard contacts 0; missing hardware contacts 0

tests.expected: Specified oriented axes, limits, named poses and symmetric 0-25 mm gripper
tests.actual: All four rotary directions match exactly; point-to-required-line distances are 0.0 mm; limits and named poses match; coupled fingers each move 12.5 mm for 25 mm opening
tests.tolerance: exact direction/limits/poses; measured line distance 0.0 mm

tests.expected: Five absolute states clear; 33 samples over 8 s with no new collision
tests.actual: Five checks clear with zero issues; linear home/reach/open/folded/home animation is 8.0 s, 33/33 samples clear and zero collisions
tests.tolerance: exact counts and duration; zero issues/collisions

tests.expected: 18 independently selectable printed definitions, declared orientations, each <=220 x 220 x 250 mm
tests.actual: 18 definitions are individually represented in the BOM. Native local bounds mapped by their declared -Z/+Z/+X orientations all fit; largest is tray at 200 x 180 x 10 mm
tests.tolerance: each printer X/Y<=220 mm and Z<=250 mm; exact direction equality

tests.expected: One bounded FDM screen; identity-classified results, retaining not-measured fields
tests.actual: One FDM run completed with PETG metadata, 1.2 mm wall threshold and 220 x 220 x 250 mm volume. Selection scoping was unavailable in the resulting check, so findings cover the whole design and are classified by exact component identity; purchased standoff 1.15 mm and washer 1.00 mm are the two errors
tests.tolerance: one run; 1.2 mm wall screen; explicit identity classification

tests.expected: Specified board, CM5, four standoffs and servo reference envelopes
tests.actual: PCB 160 x 90 x 1.6 mm at required bounds; CM5 55 x 40 x 4.621 mm; four 6 mm standoffs at required XY points; three MG996R and two MG90S envelopes with specified native dimensions. Exact full provenance-hash preservation belongs to creation metadata and was not revalidated geometrically

tests.expected: Exactly one native home isometric, top and front capture
tests.actual: One isometric, one top and one front orthographic capture were produced for revision 7/build 780f3196-07b2-4590-b102-1cdd9a73b6cf
tests.tolerance: capture count exactly 1 per named view

unresolved_findings: R01 lacks a native per-instance coincident-body/topology/revision diff and native kernel tolerance.
R04 lacks an explicitly listed complete stationary-group bounding-box measurement.
R05 lacks exact reserved-electronics-bay intersection volumes for all five states.
R08 lacks minimum-distance results for every relevant printed pair at every one of the 33 path samples; no continuous collision-freedom claim is made.
R09 has four unique cradle definitions rather than the required five, and isolated boss-web volumes were not measured.
R10 lacks explicit hardware component-pair contacts and a complete measured M5/M3 stack-order register.

The FDM validator applied the check to the whole design despite show filtering; +Z is therefore not the declared build orientation for tray or +X-oriented printed definitions. Overhang results for those identities are observations from this bounded run, not orientation acceptance.
Support volume, bridge spans, slicing, surface finish, physical fit, strength, payload, stability, powered operation and manufacturing readiness remain unverified.
